headword: {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}

definitions.explanation: A style of cooking originating in Buddhist temples that uses no meat, fish, or other animal products. Emphasizes seasonal vegetables, tofu, and grains.

examples.japanese: {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: You can enjoy Buddhist vegetarian cuisine at this temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I had authentic Buddhist vegetarian cuisine at a long-established restaurant in Kyoto.

notes:
USAGE:
{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり} is a traditional Japanese cuisine rooted in Buddhist practice. The word ⟦{精進|しょうじん}→精進：13788_shoujin⟧ means devotion or abstinence (from meat and strong-flavored vegetables), and ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ means cooking. Many temples, especially in Kyoto and on Mount Koya ({高野山|こうやさん}), serve this cuisine to visitors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (a restaurant serving Buddhist cuisine)
- {精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (to savor Buddhist cuisine)
- ⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり} (authentic Buddhist cuisine)
